reviewer: n8-30 review service (independent; did not author N8-03)
notes: N-a P3/P4 have every variable pinned (B=1024, tpw=4, cpu_budget=4, 12 GiB, checkpoint 1, env unset, scene, expected outputs) but no shipped driver accepts those flags: tools/optimization_v8/n8_03_smoke_scene.py exposes only --memory-budget-gib. Executing P3/P4 requires a small comparison-harness driver (owned by the comparison task). No parameter would need inventing; the driver must exist before the first timed pair.

N-b P3 entry says 'timed = run_utci_tiles / packed run_tile' - an either/or between two different boundaries. The comparison task must pin ONE boundary for P3/P4 and use it for both arms of every pair; the frozen gate text ('at the installed region/pipeline boundary') already requires same-boundary pairing, but the cell text should not leave the choice open.

N-c smoke records identify scenes by path + label, not by input hash. The scenes are immutable and hash-pinned via the manifests, so identity holds today; timed-run records should embed the input sha256 set (or a fixture tree digest) so identity survives any regeneration.

N-d unit labels: protocol P1 '~2.22 GiB (simulation ~1.78 GiB + parent ~0.43 GiB)' and the ambient note's 'available >= ~4.5 GiB' are decimal-GB readings of byte counts (2,211,245,261 B = 2.06 GiB; required available 4.42e9 B = 4.12 GiB). The smoke records' own GiB conversions (e.g. 1.716) are correct. Error is in the conservative (stricter) direction; cosmetic one-line clarification suggested.

N-e T1 pins the reference scene's manifest.json (fe013dcd...) whose INTERNAL met.txt entry is stale (bc8ee636... = the 24-record derivation, vs on-disk 48-record 37132c88... - n8-02 review note N8). The protocol pins the verified on-disk hash, which is the binding value; no protocol impact.

N-f the protocol does not explicitly require a per-run output manifest (path+size+sha256 list) in every TIMED record; n8_02 did this for all 24 children and it is what makes pairwise bitwise identity provable from raw. Recommend the comparison harness carry the n8_02 output_manifest pattern into every timed record.

N-g PR1's SOLWEIG_LIGHT_LW_BACKEND=numba is not a recognized backend value at HEAD (accepted: native/ispc, cylinder_longwave.py:200-201), so at HEAD it resolves to the default Numba kernel - i.e. identity with A0, which is exactly the protected-cell semantics (0% regression now; opt-out guard once alternate arms exist). Recorded so nobody mistakes the current trivial pass for evidence.
